hints.title: Complete Bin Listing
hints.text: All 4 bins: "[0-5>", "[5-10>", "[10-15>", and "15 or more" must appear even when count is 0.

hints.title: Duration Conversion
hints.text: Calculate duration in minutes using duration / 60.

hints.title: Bin Union or Conditional Aggregation
hints.text: Union the four static bins and left join session duration counts matching each range.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT '[0-5>' AS bin, SUM(duration / 60 < 5) AS total FROM Sessions
UNION
SELECT '[5-10>' AS bin, SUM(duration / 60 >= 5 AND duration / 60 < 10) AS total FROM Sessions
UNION
SELECT '[10-15>' AS bin, SUM(duration / 60 >= 10 AND duration / 60 < 15) AS total FROM Sessions
UNION
SELECT '15 or more' AS bin, SUM(duration / 60 >= 15) AS total FROM Sessions;
```

complexity.notes: Scanning the Sessions table 4 times or in a single union pass executes in linear time with 4 constant output rows.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Grouping by a calculated CASE statement omits empty bins where no sessions fall into that bracket.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Unioning predefined literal bins guarantees output completeness regardless of data distribution.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Ensuring non-existent bins are represented with 0 counts using UNION of literals.

UNION

UNION

solutions.approach: Static Bin Union with Boolean Aggregation

solutions.code:
SELECT '[0-5>' AS bin, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN duration / 60.0 < 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total FROM Sessions
UNION ALL
SELECT '[5-10>' AS bin, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN duration / 60.0 >= 5 AND duration / 60.0 < 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total FROM Sessions
UNION ALL
SELECT '[10-15>' AS bin, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN duration / 60.0 >= 10 AND duration / 60.0 < 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total FROM Sessions
UNION ALL
SELECT '15 or more' AS bin, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN duration / 60.0 >= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total FROM Sessions;

import pandas as pd

def create_bar_chart(sessions: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    b1 = ((sessions['duration'] / 60) < 5).sum()
    b2 = (((sessions['duration'] / 60) >= 5) & ((sessions['duration'] / 60) < 10)).sum()
    b3 = (((sessions['duration'] / 60) >= 10) & ((sessions['duration'] / 60) < 15)).sum()
    b4 = ((sessions['duration'] / 60) >= 15).sum()
    return pd.DataFrame([
        {'bin': '[0-5>', 'total': b1},
        {'bin': '[5-10>', 'total': b2},
        {'bin': '[10-15>', 'total': b3},
        {'bin': '15 or more', 'total': b4}
    ])
solutions.approach: Pandas Vectorized Boolean Sum per Bin
